financial_anchor.metric: Q2 2026 revenue and GAAP income before taxes
financial_anchor.caveat: Quarter-only GAAP pretax basis; ChampionX contributed $870m revenue and acquisition mix affects comparability.

ai_claim.claim: SLB reported that Digital revenue rose 18% year over year to $697m and that digital, AI and data-driven workflows are active in subsurface and operational decisions.
ai_claim.stage: E1/E2 issuer-reported active workflows and commercial demand; no controlled outcome or E4
ai_claim.limitation: No Lumi-specific customer cohort, matched field KPI, causal margin lift or retained-cash bridge.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: oil cycles, offshore mix and ChampionX integration dominate results.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Does not itself disprove the scoped mechanism.

rights_limit: Public terms do not prove universal training or pooled cross-customer reuse; enterprise schedules were unavailable.
materiality_summary: $50.9m = 5% of Q2 2026 GAAP income before taxes of $1.018bn. This is a quarter-only, pre-tax screen and is NOT_COMPARABLE with the annual benefit illustration; no annualization is assumed.

arithmetic.inputs: assumed $6bn annual own engineering, field-service and digital-operations expense pool; efficiency 12%; realization 40%; retained share 50%; recurring cost $100m
arithmetic.formula: eligible cost × efficiency × realization × retained share − recurring AI expense
